mechanics.claim: Basic attacks and damaging abilities apply a Hemorrhage stack that refreshes duration on reapplication.
mechanics.quote: damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Hemorrhage'' to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications

mechanics.claim: Attacks and abilities must actually deal damage to apply or refresh Hemorrhage; it can also be applied on-hit.
mechanics.quote: '''Darius'''' attacks and abilities have to deal damage to apply ''Hemorrhage''.

mechanics.claim: When Darius applies 5 stacks to an enemy champion, he becomes empowered with Noxian Might and instantly applies 5 Hemorrhage stacks through his usual means.
mechanics.quote: '''Darius''' gains {{pplevel|30; then +5*x for 9; then +10*x for 3; then +25*x|formula=30 + 5 per level until level 10, then + 10 per level until level 13, then + 25 per level|color=AD}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}} and instantly applies 5 ''Hemorrhage'' stacks through his usual means.

mechanics.claim: Hemorrhage deals bonus damage (250%) against monsters, not against champions.
Spell shield only blocks Hemorrhage's application from abilities, not from basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} prevents ''Hemorrhage's'' application from abilities only.
